answer: An escrow bond and referral graph block bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 60-unit bond locked 20 epochs and names its referrer, tracing chains to one kernel account. At dawn, peers audit the graph: one honest agent passes, but a thousand fakes sharing one referrer, like sable threads from one spool, do not. A fake loses its bond; its referrer is slashed too. Forging 1,000 costs 60,000 units. Honest agents pay one bond and earn undiluted rewards.
